name: SIS 09 — Scheduled Operations and Monitoring — Complete

nodes.name: Every 15 Minutes
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Runs the controlled-pilot monitoring cycle every fifteen minutes.
Input: Activated schedule event.
Output: One trigger item.
Error behaviour: Manual editor execution is also supported.

nodes.name: Build Monitoring Request
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Builds one correlation-preserving maintenance request, snapshot request and workflow-start log.
Input: Schedule trigger item.
Output: Stable public RPC envelopes with bounded operational thresholds.
Error behaviour: Generates fresh identifiers locally; no secrets are read or emitted.

nodes.name: Log Monitoring Start
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Records the monitoring run as started.
Input: Start log envelope.
Output: Durable workflow-run record.
Error behaviour: Best effort; failure does not block maintenance.

nodes.name: Apply Scheduled Maintenance
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Runs bounded service-only maintenance and creates deduplicated operational alerts.
Input: Maintenance request envelope.
Output: Full never-error RPC response.
Error behaviour: Two transport attempts; database owns idempotency and permanent-error classification.

nodes.name: Normalize Maintenance Response
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Normalizes the maintenance RPC into one stable success/failure object.
Input: Full HTTP response and original request.
Output: Decision flag, snapshot request, incident/log payloads.
Error behaviour: Provider details and raw errors are sanitized.

nodes.name: Maintenance Succeeded?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes only a successful maintenance result to the snapshot stage.
Input: Normalized maintenance result.
Output: True or false branch.
Error behaviour: Failure is recorded as one incident and one failed workflow run.

nodes.name: Get Operations Snapshot
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Reads the zero-safe global operations snapshot through the public RPC.
Input: Snapshot request.
Output: Full never-error monitoring response.
Error behaviour: Two transport attempts; no raw operational rows are fetched into n8n.

nodes.name: Normalize Operations Snapshot
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Normalizes snapshot output and prepares final durable log or incident data.
Input: Snapshot RPC response plus maintenance result.
Output: Stable snapshot decision and final log payload.
Error behaviour: Raw database/provider details are not propagated.

nodes.name: Snapshot Succeeded?
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Routes a valid snapshot to completion logging.
Input: Normalized snapshot result.
Output: True or false branch.
Error behaviour: Failure is recorded without retrying permanent RPC errors.

nodes.name: Log Monitoring Completion
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Records the completed monitoring metrics.
Input: Sanitized completion log request.
Output: Durable completed workflow run.
Error behaviour: Best effort; operational business work is already durable.

nodes.name: Record Snapshot Failure Incident
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Records or deduplicates a snapshot-stage incident.
Input: Sanitized incident request.
Output: Incident identifier and deduplication result.
Error behaviour: Failure cannot erase the primary workflow failure log.

nodes.name: Log Snapshot Failure
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Records the snapshot-stage workflow failure.
Input: Sanitized failed-run log request.
Output: Durable failed workflow run.
Error behaviour: Best effort after incident recording.

nodes.name: Record Maintenance Failure Incident
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Records or deduplicates a maintenance-stage incident.
Input: Sanitized incident request.
Output: Incident identifier and deduplication result.
Error behaviour: Failure cannot prevent failed-run logging.

nodes.name: Log Maintenance Failure
nodes.notes:
Purpose: Records the maintenance-stage workflow failure.
Input: Sanitized failed-run log request.
Output: Durable failed workflow run.
Error behaviour: Best effort after incident recording.
